fields.problem: Missing organ boundaries and incorrect organ types in 3D medical image segmentation due to lack of inductive bias in Transformers.
fields.motivation: Large-kernel depthwise convolutions can approximate Transformer receptive fields with lower parameter complexity and preserved inductive bias.
fields.methodology: Simulate Swin Transformer shift-window self-attention via 4-branch depthwise convolutions (9x9x9, 7x7x7, 5x5x5, 3x3x3) and 3D axial sparse MLP.
fields.architecture: U-shaped network with 4-stage encoder using ULD blocks (BLDC + UMLP) and Swin UNETR CNN decoder.
fields.datasets: BTCV (30 CT), FLARE 2021 (30 CT), AMOS 2022 (300 CT)
fields.reported_results: Mean Dice: BTCV 0.887, FLARE 2021 0.806, AMOS 2022 0.915 (outperforming Swin UNETR and nnU-Net).
